reviews.text:
In one week, they managed to stuff our cat with unnecessary medications. Needless to say, since after we left, they called to say that it wasn't the one the doctor prescribed, but another one 🤷‍♂️
After a week, they managed to tell us that they couldn't provide it because it wasn't their area of ​​expertise, which they knew a week earlier, but they could generously recommend someone now!
The fact that an assistant who ran over from another ward during an examination last week said that she accidentally shot the dog with a vaccine only confirms my opinion that this is more like a pharmacy, but not even appropriate for one!

Edit:
Responding half a year after the incident is at least as hypocritical as sending an appointment booking email citing a chip number reported as euthanized by another veterinarian!

magic trick
[thanks to the district veterinarian]

red we played with a string about 15 cm long with the cat. then it jumps. I pull it away when something else distracts me for a while and as I pick up the string I see the end of the string in the cat's mouth again and then it disappears. I chase it to get it out but I can't catch up. I think what goes in has to come out and maybe we wait longer than Ildomos but finally an x-ray is taken after the contrast material is injected, x-ray again but there is no pathological change induced by the string nor is the red string itself anywhere. time passes slowly we trust and hope that we have escaped. at most the cat has one life out of nine what luck when I feel like I have to go out. then I look down and there is the red string
Although coming over means there’s an issue with our pet, the service and the care are amazing! We are always well taken care of and the doctors are super friendly

Protect your little animals. We are currently fighting to repair the enormous damage they caused. This could cost our dog its life.

As soon as we get through this, I will tell you everything in detail!

And they charge you an outrageous amount of money! In my opinion, they don’t even seem interested in actually treating the animals — all they seem to care about is how they can cause more problems and squeeze as much money out of you as possible.

We had a very serious dental surgery with our elderly and epileptic puppy. We went to the clinic on a recommendation, they were recommended by a doctor at the University. We are incredibly grateful to the team, doctors Petra Renner, Ákos Lini and Laura Szücs. Petra is the kindest veterinarian I have ever met, she was very prepared, very reassuring throughout - and we were very nervous before her. Every time we visited we had only good experiences in every way. Of course it is not the cheapest, but that was not a consideration for us this time. And we are not from Pest, but there is no question of taking the puppy anywhere else, whatever he may need.

Dear Adam!
Thank you very much for the positive feedback! We wish Frici good health!

Your friend's cat was treated perfectly, at a very high cost. 😂
There's obviously a reason for this, but it's certain that the sick animal is receiving perfect care. …

Thank you very much for your trust and kind review! We were happy to help! 
We wish the kittens good health!
All such feedback means a lot to our team. Thank you and we wish Miszlik good health!

Every time we have received very high quality care, attention, and kindness, we have been going to the clinic for half a year now. The receptionists are also nice, lively, and coordinate the many small patients and their owners well. What is a special positive is that they never “slip” with the appointments, you can plan the day when you arrive for an examination. It is not the cheapest clinic, for sure, but there are no hidden costs, deductions, everything is transparent in the treatments and on the bill. The personality and expertise of Dr. Tímea Bognár help me not to worry for a minute about my dog’s health.

Addition: my dog ​​recently needed surgery, which was performed at the Veterinary University. All the doctors at the university noted that the ultrasound examinations performed at the District Veterinarian are thorough, reliable, and professionally detailed.
Thank you very much for your trust and rating!

We are very grateful to the doctor and the entire team for their kindness and attention! ❤️ They welcomed us even though we didn't have an appointment because our cat was in pain and we were very worried about him.

From the first moment, you could feel how much they love animals. They examined our cat very patiently and attentively, and even gave him a little treat, which Merlin happily accepted.🥹🐱

The clinic is also very modern, clean and comfortable, so we were greeted by a pleasant environment upon arrival. It was a very reassuring feeling to have our cat in such caring and animal-loving hands.

We will definitely come back here again and we wholeheartedly recommend them to others! ❤️
Knowledgeable, kind people, tidy, beautiful building.
Thank you for your trust and kind review!

Amazing clinic with very helpful and friendly staff. We go to Dr. Paul Robert and Dr. Lini Ákos, and both are amazing.

When we went to Dr. Paul, he was incredibly detailed in explaining everything. He basically wrote down everything about our cat on paper, which I found amazing because it can be very helpful for future visits and makes it easier to keep track of her condition.

Dr. Lini is the same. We took our cat to him for a dental check-up, and he could have simply checked her teeth and told us what needed to be done. Instead, he went above and beyond by showing us every single problem with her teeth and explaining how we were going to address each one. He also took the time to explain all the medical terms in a simple and easy-to-understand way, which we really appreciated. On top of that, he was extremely kind, gentle with our cat, which made the whole experience much more comfortable for her and for us.

Amazing veterinary clinic the best I’ve seen so far in Budapest!
We always go here with the boys. They are very kind, very professional and treat our dogs with love and are patient with us. 😁🥰🐶🩷🐾

It is deeply disappointing that so many people without real knowledge can call themselves veterinarians, I am sorry that this profession is getting worse and worse, and it is almost impossible to find a veterinarian who can do more than just microchip and vaccinate your pet. It is terrible. Dr. Péter Kapp is a truly excellent specialist, unfortunately you can no longer make an appointment with him. That is why he was the only good one there, so the fact that you can no longer go to him is worthless, but the fact that he has gathered so many inexperienced, uncaring people around him is regrettable and sad. I hope his eyes open one day.
Every positive feedback means a lot to our team. Thank you Gergő!

Negative experiences: 1. The "doctor" recommended that I treat the swollen wound on one of my cats' heads with a disinfectant. If the cat had been examined properly, it would have turned out that the periosteum was damaged, which ultimately led to a tumor and the cat could not be saved, but it cost 300,000 HUF for the tests. 2. My other cat was vomiting, had diarrhea, and had a fever. After an ultrasound and several tests, they asked for a lot of money and could not tell me what was wrong with the cat. Finally, based on my own idea, with a little diet and anti-inflammatory medication, she luckily recovered. 3. Another cat of mine could not close her mouth and her tongue was hanging out. They rummaged through her mouth for 14 minutes, examining it thoroughly, and found nothing. In another clinic, they found and removed a piece of litter stuck between her teeth in 3 minutes. Which, as they showed, was clearly visible to the naked eye. 4. Tímea Bognár and Eszter Mészáros, having paid for their "services" several times, were unable to remove an ear parasite from the cat. 5. Rudolf Horváth examined the cat and, in the process, could not offer anything worthwhile other than "I don't know" and "this is very interesting". He prescribed a preparation developed for dogs to alleviate the symptoms and later asked if the preparation had solved the cat's problem, which he himself only recommended for symptomatic, temporary treatment. 6. The cat mentioned in point 5, due to the "interesting" problem unknown to Rudolf, has weakened and is currently in a life-threatening condition. They could not accept him for an infusion or a blood test for the laboratory without an appointment. 7. Dr. Horváth also performed a series of examinations and treatments on another cat, which were occasionally expensive. In the end, the cat remained sick and was treated elsewhere. 8. One of my elderly cats was old and they didn't tell her that she was suffering and had to be put down (which happened within 4 days), but after the lab results (which showed kidney failure), they gave her an infusion, examined her, asked for another lab and finally put her down with about +250,000 forints in their pocket. But I won't go into more detail. The point is that medical treatment, apart from administering mandatory vaccinations and taking blood (although as I read the opinions, this doesn't always work), can hardly cure anything, but they charge a lot of money for nothing. I went here because it's close and because Péter Kapp is a very good doctor (he no longer accepts patients, only the owner of the clinic is) and he has already saved the life of my cat who was misdiagnosed elsewhere. In 10 years, I left millions of dollars in money there and only Péter did appreciable work. So that it is no longer possible to make an appointment at a good time, the institution is a waste of money. Even in the positive reviews, they only write that the staff and doctors are nice... But if someone goes with a real problem, in most cases they can go somewhere else, after the money is gone, the problem remains.

Requested an EU passport for a dog. Fine. Both when requesting and picking it up the staff insisted we would need tapeworm treatment 24-48 h before entering Austria, which is not true. Tapeworm treatment within the EU is only needed for Finland, Malta, Norway, Ireland and Northern Ireland, and the time window is 24-120h before for all of them. Got a strong upsell feeling and the comment from the receptionist was "ok, if you say it is not required, then it is not required." This is not how it works! There are laws and regulations that we need to adhere to.
If I cannot trust the vet to  tell me the facts in this, then what about other topics?

The name leads you to think this is a public service but in fact it is a private clinic. The company data is nowhere to be found on the website. Red flag.
Thank you for the kind, positive feedback!
Great help and professionalism.

We received a very kind and professional service! My cat is basically very afraid of the vet (I'm sure I'm not alone in this), but he has never been treated so well anywhere: patiently, so that the cat doesn't have a bad experience, kindly, without nagging the poor thing. Thank you very much! 😊

Greetings.
A few "small" comments.
First of all!!! The doctors are prepared, kind, cute... (like everywhere)

The team, together, is profit-oriented! Of course, we understand 😉
(an economic organization whose primary goal is profit, the production and maximization of profit for the owners.)
I have been lucky enough to visit the team of the district veterinary clinic several times in the past few weeks. I asked for a quote for an ultrasound examination to determine pregnancy, if it brings a positive result, for a cesarean section, and for neutering. (The total amount was about 320,000.-) The 43,000.- forint offer I received for an ultrasound examination due eight days later seemed expensive at first, but since the examination fee had to be paid in advance, there was not much time to look around, which unfortunately I only did afterwards. We know, we understand that in today's world, keeping a pet is a luxury....according to the "team"... oh well!!!
I asked for information from two official animal hospitals.
Ultrasound examination 15 minutes duration: 11,000.-
Cesarean section and neutering with lab test, package 100,000.-
That's a total of 111,000,
compared to 320,000.-
That's 3x!
Not 20% or 30%... the difference, right?!
I recently bought heartworm pills from the ladies sitting behind the computer at the same counter... I got Nexguard for the two dogs for barely 40,000.- forints, despite the fact that our dogs have been receiving Bravecto for years, which we almost always bought here, it's also on the machine. I could go back to buying Milprazon for the two months until they can get Nexguard, which is now waiting on the shelf. For 40 thousand 😉

My comment: professionalism should not only extend to pricing,
but also to other areas.
Thanks
Zsolt Balássy
Peggy

We have been going to Kerületi ever since, everyone is very kind, thorough and prepared. We have only had positive experiences. The appointment booking system works great, we never have to wait more than 5 minutes. 🐾
The doctors are nice and the receptionists are nice too🥰🥰 …

We took my 10-year-old cat for a full check-up in January. I liked that there were test packages.
When we arrived at the clinic, they called us in on time, the tests were done very quickly, and the doctor explained everything and answered our questions. We agreed that we should come back for a check-up in six months because of the slightly elevated liver values ​​and minimal crystals and protein in the urine.
During the tests, there was also an ultrasound, which resulted in the cat's belly being shaved.
As agreed, we came back in six months.
We also showed the cat's belly, where the hair has not grown back since.
The doctor stated that this was definitely not because of the shaving, which I obviously did not want to argue with her, she probably knew better. However, it is a fact that this was not the first time I had taken the cat for an ultrasound, the hair on her belly had been cut off, but I had never experienced anything like this.
Before the check-up, when we asked for an appointment, they said that it would be better to take the urine there, because then it wouldn't stay in the fridge overnight. I didn't want to squeeze my cat, but since we had no luck with the urine collection litter the day before, we decided to take the sample there.
When we arrived, our cat was very tense, so the doctor didn't want to take the samples to the lab, even though that was the purpose of the check-up. I insisted on taking the urine, which was done, but unfortunately the blood test didn't.
The urine ended up standing there for a day, after it was sent for testing, we saw this on the results sheet.
When the results came in, we called them because we had a few questions. They said they would call back during the day, but they didn't. The next day we were again unsuccessful, finally on the third day I called them again to say that I did not consider this attitude correct, we turned to them with confidence and paid a lot of money for the tests. So we managed to get information with great difficulty, although they could not tell us the reason for the baldness on the belly or the minimal protein in the urine. My cat's fur has not grown back since then, we have tried everything. I have mixed feelings.

They are very helpful and their attitude is exemplary. They don't delay, they immediately called my dog ​​in for treatment and fortunately he has been recovering nicely since then. From now on, I only want to go to them.

My review is focused only on veterinary Eszter Mészáros.
I had 2 bad experiences with her.
First case: my dog had a wound in her leg and veterinary Eszter attended us in a very rude way. She was treating my dog like an object, without empathy at all. Then she started to clean the wound to make it bleed again to be able to clean it, and my dog started to cry. She just told that my dog shouldn't be crying because of that, and that it was not painful at all (my dog only cries in extremely painful situations). After that she was pressing a bandage so hard that my dog started to cry a bit again.
Then the bandage was applied excessively tight, which impeded blood circulation in my dog’s paw. The paw became swollen over time, and I had to re-dress it.

Second case: my dog broke the tip of her tail and I took her directly to the clinic, where only veterinary Eszter Mészáros was available. I had immobilized the tail beforehand to prevent further damage. When I arrived, I explained what happened and started to carefully remove the temporary wrap. She rudely told me to step aside and said she would do it. She pulled the wrap off in one motion instead of gently unwrapping it.
She said the tail was probably fractured and that an X-ray was needed to confirm. She then put my dog on the floor with no immobilization and walked her to the X-ray room while the tail was swinging freely, which could cause more damage. After the X-ray, my dog still had no immobilization and the tail kept swinging. There was no care to keep the tail stable to avoid further injury.
Throughout this visit she was rude and showed no empathy for the situation. She later showed me the X-ray confirming the fracture, explained the options, and said she would immobilize the tail. Again, she moved my dog without stabilizing the tail. She gave an injection and prescribed medication for six days. Two days later, the immobilization she applied fell off completely in one piece, which shows it was not secured properly.

My main complaint is the way she treated us and the lack of care to provide the best clinical treatment for my dog. I also spoke with a group of friends who take their dogs to the same clinic, and everyone who was seen by her at some point complained about something. Issues such as:

- Prescribing an incorrect eye drop that worsened an infection, and as a result the dog almost lost the eye.
- Being rude to clients, which led them to stop booking appointments with her.
- Treating a friend rudely during a simple vaccination visit and doubting everything she said about procedures already done in Brazil, such as vaccines, deworming, and spay.
- Handling a dog with a swollen ear poorly when the dog resisted handling, including stating she was afraid of dogs barking.

To be clear, I have been a client of this clinic for over four years, since they operated at the smaller location, and I have only had problems with this particular veterinarian in emergency situations. In regular appointments, the other veterinarians have always treated us very well.
I went there with my cat today. The staff is flexible and kind. The doctor treated my timid cat with great care.

Super kind, helpful.

Reliability, expertise and genuine care – the best place to take your pet

We have been to the District Veterinary Clinic several times, and each time we have been confirmed that our little pet is in the best hands. Even at the first visit, the team working there made a very positive impression on us: we were greeted kindly at the reception, we didn’t have to wait long, and everyone was very helpful and patient with us.

The veterinarian was not only extremely professionally prepared, but also outstanding as a person. He spoke in a calm, reassuring tone, explained in detail what was happening and why he was doing it, and always took time for our questions. We felt that here they really don’t treat animals on an assembly line, but that they pay individual attention to each little patient. The examinations were carried out thoroughly, and the animal’s comfort was taken into account even when it was more timid.

The clinic is clean, well-equipped, and the entire team works together smoothly. I would like to highlight that we received useful advice not only on diseases, but also on general care, nutrition, and prevention. We clearly had the feeling that they not only treat animals here, but also do their work with love and dedication.

I sincerely recommend the District Veterinarian to every responsible owner who is not only looking for a professional, but also a humane, conscientious, and reliable veterinarian. We definitely won't go anywhere else!
The receptionist is an incredible jerk! She wears glasses and braces. She's so phlegmatic...

Review from 07/05/2025, 15:00 — Dr. Horváth Rudolf (Pet Passport Application)

I regret to say that my visit to the clinic was a deeply upsetting experience.

Although I had made an appointment with Dr. Horváth, he did not see us. Instead, we were spoken to by a lady at the reception whose behavior was extremely rude, dismissive, and completely unacceptable. She was visibly irritated and refused to communicate, despite my friend being ready to help translate over the phone. The atmosphere was so hostile that even my nine-year-old dog got nervous.

I do not speak Hungarian, and my English is limited — but that should not be a reason to treat me this way. They said that next time I could only come if I had someone with me who spoke Hungarian or English. Otherwise, they would simply not see me.

It’s hard to describe, but the whole situation made me feel like I was the victim of racist or homophobic discrimination. Maybe I’m wrong — I’d like to believe it was just incompetence or personal dislike. But the way I was treated was discrimination. In a private veterinary clinic. In the middle of Europe. In 2025. This is unacceptable.

I am a Russian citizen. I respect all cultures and nations — and I expect the same respect for myself. I sincerely hope that the pet’s passport will be issued in a timely and proper manner. And I trust that this unpleasant experience was just an isolated incident, and not a general characteristic of the clinic or Hungarian society.
Every time we went they were completely correct, professional and kind. I can recommend them to anyone who needs them.

If I could, I would give them a thousand stars!!! We went there with my Birman cat Hugo because of urination problems. Hugo almost fell asleep during the ultrasound examination, Julianna Rácz treated him so kindly, gently, patiently and professionally, and the assistants treated him perfectly as well. I can only say good things about the Doctor, she is infinitely kind, calm, patient, meticulous and conscientious, she responded to every little question and comment I had in detail, she informed and informed me as professionally as possible, every owner can relax with her! My best experience so far with an animal hospital, doctor (Juliana Rácz) and all the staff at the clinic. And it is not overpriced at all, as was read in a few reviews here, they work at completely average prices. But basically, for this attitude and treatment, I would gladly spend even triple that much and would never go anywhere else from here. I am unspeakably satisfied. Infinite gratitude for showing us that it's okay to treat them/us this way after a terrible experience elsewhere. Thank you! 🥰

I have nothing but praise for the Dr., he was highly professional and kind, the only positive aspect of this clinic. Unfortunately, everything else feels like a scam. I visited for a consultation before sterilizing my cat. After a quick examination, the doctor strongly recommended a blood test to ensure everything was fine before the procedure, without mentioning any costs.
Trusting it would be reasonably priced, I agreed, only to be shocked at the final bill: 41,000 HUF, nearly the same price as the surgery itself, which costs 48,000 HUF. The clinic justified the charge by claiming the doctor had explained everything in detail, using technical terms that were beyond my understanding.
In reality, it was just a basic check-up, and the price was insane. After researching, I found equally competent vets offering the same services for half the cost. Don’t be fooled by their English-speaking staff; you’re better off using a translator than overpaying here!
